Base value of a game type

Source: R/bidding.R
sk_base_value.Rd

The multiplier base used in Skat game-value computation: diamonds 9, hearts 10, spades 11, clubs 12, grand 24. Null games use fixed values instead and return NA here.

Usage

sk_base_value(game_type, call = rlang::caller_env())

Arguments

game_type

A single game-type string, one of sk_game_types().

call

The calling environment, used for error reporting.

Value

A single integer base value, or NA_integer_ for "null".

See also

sk_game_value(), which multiplies this by the matador multiplier.

Other bidding functions: sk_game_value(), sk_matadors()

Examples

sk_base_value("clubs")
#> [1] 12
sk_base_value("grand")
#> [1] 24
sk_base_value("null")
#> [1] NA
